critical_code_review_comments: nl_routes.nl_strategy_apply default risk_level falls back to 'medium' (line 139) but elsewhere the API canonicalises to 'low'/'middle'/'high' (see _set_risk_level VALID_LEVELS). If a NL-compiled strategy omits risk_level, the bot_config row is stamped with the legacy 'medium' string. Recommend aligning to {'low','middle','high'} or documenting the synonym.
signal_routes.generate_signal does the same fallback (risk_level='medium') — same alignment note. Low priority as analyze_symbol handles unknown levels.

nl_strategy_apply hard-codes default symbols ['XAUUSD','BTCUSD'] when compiled.symbols is missing (line 140). Silent default could pick wrong target set for users without those symbols configured. Consider 422 instead.

Audit row schema returned by apply_to_bot_configs is not documented in the route response model. The HTTP smoke test asserts 'config_id or _id or user_id' since the exact key was unclear from the route — recommend a Pydantic response_model so the frontend can rely on the shape.
